hazards.description_es: There is no handrail along the stairs to hold. A person can lose balance and fall.
hazards.fix_es: Add a strong handrail along the wall of the stairs and fix it tight to the wall.

hazards.description_es: A pair of shoes is left on a step. A foot can catch on them and cause a trip.
hazards.fix_es: Move the shoes off the stairs right now. Keep the stairs always clear.

hazards.description_es: A box is sitting on a lower step. A person can trip over it when going up or down.
hazards.fix_es: Move the box off the stairs right now. Store it in another room.

hazards.description_es: A small blue object is on an upper step. It can be stepped on and cause a slip.
hazards.fix_es: Move the blue object off the stairs right now. Keep all steps empty.
